contributions.statement: Do not rely on prompt-level injection defenses or heuristic detectors alone; prompt defenses reduced but never eliminated attack success, and static detectors missed most tainted artifacts.
contributions.evidence: Table 1: pooled ASR 6.00% -> 1.69%, none at 0; Table 2: detectors 11-18% recall; one anonymised model, ~19 successes per arm.

reason: A toolkit description with a small demonstration on an anonymised model; its finding repeats what other KB papers show with better evidence.
